Diagnosis:
CAUSE: Deployment `web` in namespace `drift-lab` has drifted from its last-applied manifest, with `spec.replicas` set to 3 and the container image set to `nginx:1.26-alpine` where the last-applied configuration has 2 replicas and `nginx:1.27-alpine`.
EVIDENCE:
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab get -n drift-lab deployment web -o yaml`: `spec.replicas: 3`, but the `kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration` annotation says `"replicas":2`.
- Same command: the live container image is `docker.io/library/nginx:1.26-alpine`, but the last-applied annotation says `docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpine`.
- Same command: `metadata.generation: 3` and `deployment.kubernetes.io/revision: "2"`, so the spec changed after the last apply.
- Same command: `status.availableReplicas: 3`, `readyReplicas: 3`, and the Available and Progressing conditions are True, so the rollout itself is healthy.
- `kubectl --context kind-sre-lab diff -n drift-lab -f -` with a stripped manifest exited 2 (`spec.selector: Required value`), so it produced no live-versus-desired diff and the comparison above rests on the last-applied annotation.
FIX (not applied): Re-apply the source manifest for `drift-lab/web` with `replicas: 2` and image `nginx:1.27-alpine`, which returns the Deployment to its last-applied state.
